CUSTOM VEHICLE WRAP IN TORONTO – CAR WRAP, TRUCK, VAN WRAPS, LETTERING & DECALS

Vinyl Wrap Toronto, located in Etobicoke, is your one-stop shop for high-quality vehicle graphics and signage solutions. We specialize in vehicle wraps (full wraps, partial wraps, lettering, decals, and equipment wraps) and signage services (storefront signs, window graphics, and wall graphics). Serving both commercial and personal clients, we use premium vinyl materials like Avery Dennison, Hexis, and 3M to deliver durable, eye-catching results. Our experienced team is dedicated to helping you transform vehicles, spaces, and objects with custom designs that boost your brand and style.

Vehicle Wraps:

Full Vehicle Wraps

Transform your vehicle with a full vinyl wrap that covers every inch of its surface, providing a striking new look while protecting the original paint. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we use high-quality vinyl from trusted brands like Avery Dennison, Hexis, and 3M. Full wraps are perfect for businesses looking for maximum brand visibility or personal vehicles seeking a unique style. Whether you want a solid colour, a matte finish, or a detailed graphic design, our expert team can make your vision a reality.

Partial Vehicle Wraps

Enhance specific parts of your vehicle with a partial wrap that creates impact without covering the entire surface. Whether it’s the hood, roof, doors, or bumpers, Vinyl Wrap Toronto can strategically apply designs to maximize visual appeal and brand exposure. Ideal for businesses on a budget or personal projects, partial wraps provide flexibility and customization while protecting selected areas from wear and tear.

Vehicle Lettering & Decals

Looking for a cost-effective way to advertise your business on the go? Our vehicle lettering and decals service allows you to display your company name, contact information, and logo prominently. Using durable vinyl materials with a 3-year warranty, we ensure your message stands out on the road. Perfect for fleets, delivery vans, or personal vehicles that need a professional touch, these decals are designed for longevity and visibility.

Equipment & Object Wraps

We don’t just wrap vehicles! Vinyl Wrap Toronto specializes in wrapping a variety of equipment and objects, including motorcycles, ATVs, boats, trailers, and even industrial machinery. Give your tools, gadgets, or promotional items a branded or customized finish. Our high-quality wraps protect surfaces from scratches and UV damage while making them look stunning. No project is too unique for us to tackle.

Signage

Storefront Signs

Make a lasting first impression with custom storefront signage that showcases your brand. Vinyl Wrap Toronto offers vibrant, weather-resistant storefront signs designed to attract and engage customers. From sleek vinyl lettering to bold graphics, we help your business stand out on the street. Our team ensures the signage reflects your brand identity while providing durability against Toronto’s varied weather conditions.

Window Graphics

Maximize your advertising space with eye-catching window graphics. Whether you need promotional decals, privacy films, or full-colour window wraps, we offer solutions that enhance your storefront. Window graphics are perfect for announcing sales, showcasing products, or reinforcing brand identity. Our high-quality vinyl materials ensure longevity, vibrant colours, and easy removal when updates are needed.

Wall Graphics

Turn your walls into powerful branding tools with custom wall graphics. Perfect for offices, retail stores, and homes, our wall wraps bring creativity and personality to any space. We create everything from motivational quotes to full-scale murals. Durable and customizable, wall graphics are an affordable way to transform interiors, communicate your message, or enhance your brand’s aesthetic appeal.

Why Choose Vinyl Wrap Toronto?

  • Expert Craftsmanship: Skilled installers ensure flawless finishes.
  • Premium Materials: We use vinyl from top brands like Avery Dennison, Hexis, and 3M.
  • Warranty Protection: 3-year warranty on lettering and decals.
  • Customized Solutions: Tailored wraps and graphics for vehicles, signs, and objects.
  • Customer Satisfaction: Dedicated to delivering quality results that exceed expectations.

Ready to elevate your vehicle or brand visibility? Contact Vinyl Wrap Toronto today for a free quote!
